Planner incorrectly prioritizes the vernacular evolution (Old French) rather than the dominant Latin of the Carolingian Renaissance, leading to the wrong final answer. This mistake aligns with **Example 1**, as it incorrectly shifts focus to vernacular transmission rather than the primary root language of the era.
